acceptable.text: The web app ships a self-hosted subset of the Material Symbols font, so any icon name used in the UI must be present in apps/web/src/assets/material-symbols-subset.woff2 (regenerate it per assets/README.md) or the browser prints the raw icon name as text; a test in apps/web/src/icons.test.ts now guards this.
acceptable.evidence: the subset, the ligature never forms and the browser prints the raw word

notes: ROUTINE window (not unresolved debugging): two 'pull latest images and update the local stack' requests plus a small icon fix whose rule is already documented in the repo's assets/README.md and enforced by a new test, so nothing is non-obvious and durable; expected is []. The icon-subset gotcha is listed as acceptable only.
